home.title: SpotiGrab
home.subtitle: Paste a Spotify playlist link and automatically find matching tracks on YouTube to download locally. No more manual searching, one by one.
home.footer: For personal backup use only. Please respect music creators' copyrights and support official music platforms.

playlistInput.placeholder: Paste Spotify playlist link, e.g. https://open.spotify.com/playlist/...
playlistInput.hint: Supports public Spotify playlists. The system will automatically search for matching tracks on YouTube and download as MP3.
